messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@cloudmed.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudmed.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment wiring — MAP action items (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Hi Alex / Liam —

As discussed during last week's call I'm sending the concise mutual-action checklist we need to close the POC runway. Goal: get the staging POC environment provisioned and ready for smoke tests by Monday 21 Jun. Key items below — please confirm owners / target dates so I can update the MAP spreadsheet.

Required items (short):
- Org + tenant creation: CloudMed org in Redwood console (dedicated staging tenant) — owner: CloudMed IT.
- API keys: request production-style API key + a rotating sandbox key; define rotation TTL.
- IP allowlist: we need public egress ranges from CloudMed and your test harness IPs. See attached template for format.
- VPC peering: whether you prefer managed peering (Redwood side) or you create a peering on your VPC and share the ID. Also provide preferred maintenance window.

Attachments: MAP_CloudMed_v2.xlsx (MAP checklist), network-allowlist.csv (IP template). Also attaching a VPC peering template for reference.

Can you confirm by EOD Thursday 10 Jun on owners for org/API keys/IP ranges and whether procurement will need a SOW/addendum before we proceed? If we have confirmation then we'll lock the go/no-go and schedule the peering window.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_CloudMed_v2.xlsx (excel)]
[attachment: network-allowlist.csv (csv)]

From: Alex Romero <alex@cloudmed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudmed.com>, procurement@cloudmed.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC environment wiring — MAP action items (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick status from our side:
- Org/tenant: I can create the staging org and admin user by Friday 11 Jun. Owner: me (Alex).
- API keys: Procurement needs an internal note but technical folks are fine with two keys (staging + expiring test key). Please send key requirements (scopes, TTL).
- IP allowlist: Our infra team needs the CSV format you attached; we will return a filled file with our egress ranges and test harness addresses by Thu EOD.
- VPC peering: We prefer to create the peering on our side and share the connection info (we manage routing). Target window: Jun 20 02:00–04:00 UTC is doable if your team can staff the check.

Procurement (procurement@cloudmed.com) — are there any additional RFI/SOW asks? If yes, loop us in and we'll coordinate.

Alex
Head of Integrations, CloudMed Health
[inline: network-allowlist.csv (will return filled)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@cloudmed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC environment wiring — MAP action items (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

On Wed, Jun 9, 2027 at 10:02 AM Alex Romero <alex@cloudmed.com> wrote:
> Our infra team needs the CSV format you attached; we will return a filled file with our egress ranges and test harness addresses by Thu EOD.

Alex — thanks, that schedule works. A few technical clarifications so we avoid surprises during the peering window:

1) Org setup: please create the staging org with a single admin user and share the admin email. We will send an invite flow that provisions the RBAC template for seeding test users. If you want the org named "cloudmed-staging", say so; otherwise we'll name it per your admin email.

2) API keys: our recommended scopes for the POC (scriptable tests) are: generation:read, generation:write, embeddings:read. Sandbox key TTL: 14 days; production-style key TTL: 90 days (can be rotated earlier). If you require IP-bound API keys we can enable that — let us know.

3) IP allowlist: please include both your public NAT egress ranges and any CI/CD runner IPs. We will also provide our egress list for callback whitelisting: 34.82.10.0/24, 54.38.200.0/22 (example).

4) VPC peering checklist: if CloudMed manages the peering, we need the peering ID, your VPC CIDR, and route-table targets. If Redwood handles peering setup we will need an IAM role/temporary key to provision the peering (we can use a short-lived Service Account). Either way, confirm the route propagation plan.

Action items we will take immediately: attach updated vpc-peering-template.pdf (policy + sample commands) and I will create a 'smoke-test' checklist for after peering.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: vpc-peering-template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@cloudmed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC environment wiring — MAP action items (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Thanks everyone — quick recap and owners so we have a single-source MAP entry: 

- CloudMed: create staging org + provide admin email — owner: Alex — due 2027-06-11.
- CloudMed: return filled network-allowlist.csv with egress ranges and test IPs — owner: Alex / infra — due 2027-06-10 EOD (per Alex).
- Redwood: prepare API key scopes & rotation docs and enable IP-bound keys if requested — owner: Neha — due 2027-06-11.
- CloudMed: create VPC peering and share peering ID + CIDR, or confirm Redwood to provision — owner: Alex / infra — target peering window 2027-06-20 02:00–04:00 UTC.
- Redwood: run post-peering smoke tests (auth, generation, embeddings, KV-cache) — owner: Monica — target 2027-06-20 04:30–06:00 UTC.
- Procurement: confirm any SOW/addendum requirements for production keys — owner: procurement@cloudmed.com — requested by 2027-06-11.

I'll update the MAP_CloudMed_v2.xlsx in HubSpot (deal HSP-4821) and ping the on-call infra engineer to staff the peering window. If anyone needs a different window, flag now.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
